title: Validator Stage Profiling and Partial Validation Modes
goal: Add staged validator execution, profiling, and partial validation modes so governance failures can be localized without requiring every run to execute the full global validator.

problem_statement.current_issue: global_validate.py behaves as a monolithic validator with limited execution modes, making timeout diagnosis difficult when runtime-scale or database contention occurs.
problem_statement.risk: A tooling/runtime stall may be mistaken for semantic invalidity or may block otherwise sound governance patches.
problem_statement.needed_capability: The validator must identify which validation stage is slow, failed, skipped, stale, or semantically invalid.

basis.scope: Add bounded validation modes, stage profiling, and richer validation reports without changing semantic patch content or RT_core.

required_repo_changes.description: Add bounded validation modes, staged execution planning, stage-result reporting, and stage-level profiling without changing default semantics.
Document the new validator modes, staged report structure, and mode-specific troubleshooting guidance.

acceptance_criteria: python scripts/global_validate.py --quick completes and writes a report with validation_mode=quick.
python scripts/global_validate.py --registries-only completes without invoking full patch-gate replay.
A forced stage timeout is classified as TIMEOUT or FAIL_RUNTIME, not semantic failure.
Default global_validate.py behavior remains backward compatible.

warnings: Bounded validation modes remain additive and do not alter RT_core.
